title: R3 — tenant tokens structurally absent on refusing routes
description: Walked all four routes in the running app and read, per route: the theme grant the shell resolved, every --formspec-* custom property set anywhere inside the route subtree, and every one set on the document root. Captured by driving the app with Playwright, after the document-root workaround was added.
routeClassAuthority: ROUTE_CLASS_THEME_AUTHORITY, read from @formspec-org/app-graph, not restated by the shell
structuralClaim: resolveThemeGrant is the only reader of the tenant Theme document in the app (grep: src/theme-grant.ts is the sole importer of `tenantTheme` from src/bundle.ts). It is called once per route at the route boundary, and only grant.themeDocument crosses into RouteView. On a refusing class that object is built from the platform token registry and never saw the tenant's tokens.
honestCaveat: The shell's own boundary is structural. Keeping the DOCUMENT ROOT clean is not — it requires an active scrub, because the shipped renderer writes tenant tokens to <html> with no cleanup. See r3-document-root-leak.json.
